evidence.note: Current section 'Close' is marked in a darker blue ink with a pill highlight; the other nav items are neutral grey. Blue here marks focus (current position).
A thin blue rule under the header bar, the only accent line on the slide.
'Thank you' is set in near-black serif, with no accent, state, loss or alarm colour.
Soft, blurred pale-blue ambient blobs, strongest bottom right. They read as a low-intensity backdrop tint, not as a role colour on content.

rationale: The only saturated blue sits on the current-section nav marker and header rule, which is consistent with a focus role, and accent-coloured text uses a darker ink. No loss, alarm or state colours appear, and the text carries no role colour. The pale ambient blobs are a muted backdrop tint rather than a role colour applied to content, so no role is misused.
